title: Figure 3: Time-lapse night photo of Lightcraft outdoor vertical flight test
description: Night time-lapse photograph showing a dotted vertical streak of light rising from a test site with a crane boom, a domed structure, a small building and a trailer. Caption: "Figure 3. Time-Lapse Photo of a Lightcraft Undergoing an Outdoor Vertical Flight Test (courtesy of F. Mead, AFRL/PRSP, Edwards AFB, CA)."
